phase_desc.menstrual: Rest & replenish — focus on iron-rich and anti-inflammatory foods to ease this phase.
phase_desc.follicular: Rise & build — estrogen-supporting foods to fuel your natural energy growth.
phase_desc.ovulation: Peak & shine — light, energising foods for your highest vitality window.
phase_desc.luteal: Wind down & nourish — progesterone-friendly foods to ease the transition.

lentejas.name: Lentils
lentejas.benefit: Rich in non-heme iron to offset blood loss and zinc to support the immune system.

salmon_salvaje.name: Wild Salmon
salmon_salvaje.benefit: High in Omega-3 fatty acids that decrease the production of inflammatory prostaglandins, soothing cramps.

semillas_lino.name: Flaxseeds
semillas_lino.benefit: Contain lignanos that help balance estrogen levels and fiber to prevent constipation.

nueces.name: Walnuts
nueces.benefit: Provide healthy fats and magnesium, which contributes to uterine relaxation and reduces tension.

avena_integral.name: Whole Oatmeal
avena_integral.benefit: Slowly releases glucose, providing steady energy and stimulating serotonin to regulate mood.

quinoa.name: Quinoa
quinoa.benefit: It is a complete protein with a low glycemic index, ideal for digestive comfort.

espinacas.name: Spinach
espinacas.benefit: Great source of iron and folate. Green leaves provide fiber that aids digestion and cleansing.

fresas_berries.name: Strawberries & Berries
fresas_berries.benefit: Vitamin C promotes iron absorption and provides antioxidant polyphenols to reduce inflammation.

pollo_pastoreo.name: Pasture Chicken
pollo_pastoreo.benefit: Provides essential amino acids to build follicles and sustain the progressive rise of energy.

garbanzos.name: Chickpeas
garbanzos.benefit: Rich in phytoestrogens that gently support the estrogen rise characteristic of this phase.

semillas_calabaza.name: Pumpkin Seeds
semillas_calabaza.benefit: High in zinc, essential for correct follicular maturation and preparation for ovulation.

almendras.name: Almonds
almendras.benefit: Provide vitamin E, a potent antioxidant that nourishes follicular cell membranes.

arroz_integral.name: Brown or Wild Rice
arroz_integral.benefit: Contains B-group vitamins that assist in proper hormonal metabolization in the liver.

brocoli.name: Broccoli
brocoli.benefit: Contains indole-3-carbinol, a key compound to regulate excess estrogen and support liver detox.

aguacate.name: Avocado
aguacate.benefit: Monounsaturated healthy fats that promote oocyte quality and cervical lubrication.

pescado_blanco.name: Lean White Fish
pescado_blanco.benefit: Light, highly digestible protein, ideal to maintain physical lightness during the estrogen peak.

huevos_organicos.name: Organic Eggs
huevos_organicos.benefit: Rich in choline, vitamin D and B12, essential micronutrients to sustain oocyte quality.

semillas_sesamo.name: Sesame Seeds
semillas_sesamo.benefit: Contain calcium and zinc, minerals that support the proper release of the mature egg.

aceite_oliva.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
aceite_oliva.benefit: Reduces body oxidative stress, protecting the egg during its journey through the tubes.

quinoa_cocida.name: Cooked Quinoa
quinoa_cocida.benefit: Complete protein with low-glycemic carbs to prevent postprandial insulin spikes.

hojas_verdes.name: Leafy Greens (Arugula/Kale)
hojas_verdes.benefit: Stimulate fertile cervical mucus production and provide bioavailable calcium.

frambuesas.name: Fresh Raspberries
frambuesas.benefit: High antioxidant content neutralizes free radicals, protecting reproductive cells.

pavo.name: Lean Turkey
pavo.benefit: High in tryptophan, a serotonin and melatonine precursor, regulating mood and premenstrual rest.

legumbres.name: Legumes (Lentils/Beans)
legumbres.benefit: Provide soluble fiber that prevents constipation caused by elevated progesterone.

semillas_girasol.name: Sunflower Seeds
semillas_girasol.benefit: Rich in vitamin E and selenium, key micronutrients to nourish and extend the corpus luteum lifespan.

mantequilla_almendras.name: Almond Butter
mantequilla_almendras.benefit: Stable fats and magnesium to curb frequent sweet cravings before your period.

camote.name: Sweet Potato
camote.benefit: Provides complex carbohydrates and vitamin A, stabilizing blood sugar levels to modulate irritability.

calabaza.name: Pumpkin / Squash
calabaza.benefit: Rich in fiber and beta-carotenes. Provides natural sweet comfort to avoid bingeing.

platano.name: Banana
platano.benefit: Rich in potassium and vitamin B6, helping to reduce water retention and premenstrual bloating.
